newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firmer on Cenbnk dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firmer on Cenbnk dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer for the second day running at 492.00/493.00 per dollar as the Central Bank weighed into the market with a constant and abundant stream of dollars, traders said.
On Friday the bolivar closed at 492.25/493.25 per dollar.
"It was the Central Bank that firmed the bolivar today," said one trader.
"The Central Bank came in strong, especially in the afternoon," said another.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
